title: Der Wohlstand
description: Custom entities & items for RP purposes, thematically based on "Der Wohlstand"
body:
# Required Mods
- [EMF/ETF](https://modrinth.com/mod/entity-model-features)
- [Fusion (Conected Textures)](https://modrinth.com/mod/fusion-connected-textures)
- [Resource Pack Fusion](https://modrinth.com/mod/rpf) (only If you are using multiple Resourcepacks with item model definitions for the same items)

All these mods should install automatically.

# "Der Wohlstand"
Hi, I'm Leggar, CEO and founding Member of ["Der Wohlstand"](https://derwohlstand.com/)

![CEO Leggar](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/0eefa39c5a5f5637639264f618852f84c734acae_0.webp)
## Description
This is a resource pack is for all "Der Wohlstand" members and those we will buy later...

"Der Wohlstand" is a community that has amassed immeasurable wealth through clever import and export deals.
But our ambitions don't end with collecting diamonds or emeralds: we erect monumental structures whose size is surpassed only by our greed for wealth...

Driven by an insatiable hunger for wealth, we finance entire cities, employ countless workers, and leave our mark wherever trade is conducted. But despite our fame and influence, we are not blind to those who start small. **"Der Wohlstand"** invests in emerging companies, supports new visions, and promotes those who have the courage to embrace prosperity.

This is the legacy of “Der Wohlstand” – and every block, every chest, and every trade brings us closer to our goal: eternal wealth and unparalleled greatness.

### Theme
Everything in this pack is thematically based on “Der Wohlstand”.
